units.CD5101-kisangani: Kisangani, capital of Tshopo province, is a government-held city with no armed group controlling territory. The Congolese National Police (PNC) keep day-to-day order in all communes and neighbourhoods, while the FARDC maintain a large garrison and use Bangboka airport as a strategic logistics and air hub for eastern operations (it was reportedly targeted by long-range drones in 2025, without any change in ground control). Peri-urban and left-bank (Lubunga) villages are assessed under default state presence; Lubunga saw Mbole-Lengola intercommunal clashes in 2023 but no lasting armed-group control. Web research was unavailable for this run, so confidence is medium for the city and low elsewhere.
